1	import { balanceDue } from './payments.js';
2	import { daysBetween } from './dates.js';
3	
4	/**
5	 * Generate an overdue report for invoices past their due date.
6	 * @param {Array} invoices - All invoices
7	 * @param {string} asOf - Cutoff date in YYYY-MM-DD format
8	 * @returns {Array<{ number: string, customerId: string, dueDate: string, daysOverdue: number, due: number }>}
9	 */
10	export function overdueInvoices(invoices, asOf) {
11	  const overdue = invoices
12	    .filter((invoice) =>
13	      (invoice.status === 'issued' || invoice.status === 'partially_paid') &&
14	      invoice.dueDate < asOf
15	    )
16	    .map((invoice) => ({
17	      number: invoice.number,
18	      customerId: invoice.customerId,
19	      dueDate: invoice.dueDate,
20	      daysOverdue: daysBetween(invoice.dueDate, asOf),
21	      due: balanceDue(invoice),
22	    }))
23	    .sort((a, b) => b.daysOverdue - a.daysOverdue);
24	
25	  return overdue;
26	}
